status: ENGINEERING-WRITTEN, NOT CLINICALLY REVIEWED. A clinical lead must review every row before this table is relied on.
source_note: Written by the engineering team from common Indian hospital bill wording (USG = ultrasonography, PTCA = percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty, haemodialysis = dialysis). Not derived from the CGHS schedule or any hospital's chargemaster. Each row only rewrites a hospital spelling to the wording already used by a key in cghs_rates.json; it never adds a rate.
modifier_note: Words that change WHAT is billed or WHICH unit it is: a catheter, a report copy, follow-up drops, an image-guided procedure, a contrast agent/media/injection (a separate item even after 'with'), and negating or unit-changing qualifiers (non-ICU, step-down, paediatric, neonatal, excluding). A line containing one is refused rather than priced at the parent rate. 'contrast' directly after 'with'/'without' describes the scan itself and is not a modifier. A bare 'angioplasty' is deliberately NOT a synonym (it may be peripheral, renal, carotid...); only 'PTCA' maps to coronary angioplasty.
